name: Mekakure, Produce! ~Uchiki na Osananajimi no Sugao o Mite Mitai!~
original_name: メカクレ、プロデュース！～内気な幼馴染の素顔を見てみたいっ！～
source:
My childhood friend Mashimo Saaya. She has a few characteristics.

She has been wearing her bangs since she was a little girl, and has never shown her true face. Even I have never seen her real face.

In addition to her appearance, she has a reclusive personality. She is also a dependent person who rarely speaks to anyone but me. I decided to do something about it.

I suggested that she cut her bangs and give herself a makeover but she refused and out of embarassment.

One day, while the two of us were leaving school together, took shelter at Saaya's house because of heavy rain. Her clothes were sticking to her and she had a hard time changing. When I rolled up her school uniform to help her, my eyes were glued to her big breasts. 

Wanting to touch those huge breasts I let my impulses take control.

她从小就留着刘海，从来没有露出过自己的真面目。就连我也从未见过她的真面目。

除了外表之外，她还有着一种隐居的性格。她也是一个依赖他人的人，除了我之外很少和任何人说话。我决定为此做点什么。

我建议她剪掉刘海，打扮一下自己，但她出于尴尬而拒绝了。
